name: Deltalytix
install:
curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
bun install
bunx prisma generate
sudo apt-get update
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2 ffmpeg postgresql postgresql-client
curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh | sh
start:
bash scripts/docker-bootstrap.sh || sudo docker info >/dev/null 2>&1
if command -v tailscaled >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ! pgrep -x tailscaled >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    sudo mkdir -p /var/run/tailscale /var/lib/tailscale
    sudo tailscaled --state=/var/lib/tailscale/tailscaled.state --socket=/var/run/tailscale/tailscaled.sock --port=41641 >/tmp/tailscaled.log 2>&1 &
    for _ in $(seq 1 20); do
      if [ -S /var/run/tailscale/tailscaled.sock ]; then break; fi
      sleep 0.5
    done
  fi
  if [ -n "${TS_AUTHKEY:-}" ]; then
    sudo tailscale up --auth-key="$TS_AUTHKEY" --hostname="deltalytix-${HOSTNAME}" --accept-dns=false --operator=ubuntu --timeout=30s
  fi
fi

terminals.name: next-dev
terminals.description: Bootstrap local Postgres + start Next.js dev server
